cases.refreshed: Join our monthly "Design Your Own!" workshop, an interactive introduction to 3D Design and 3D Printing, led by the Phhs Game & App Makers Club. Using Tinkercad, a beginner-friendly CAD tool, participants learn core 3D modeling skills, apply them to design an original project, and present their work. The workshop is open to students in grades 3–12, and no prior coding or design experience is required. Program capacity: 15 participants. Free. No registration required. Fifteen tickets will be distributed 30 minutes before the event begins on a first-come, first-served basis.

cases.refreshed: Join us at the Alviso Branch Library where we will host special STEM-themed programs on the 1st & 3rd Sundays of each month. For each STEM Sunday, we will feature a fun, hands-on activity to help learners develop their science, tech, engineering, or math skills and experience. Some of the activities will be done in groups at Alviso branch while others may be kits you can work on at the library or take home! On this day, we will be doing a Chromatography Experiment. Dray on a strip of coffee filter with washable markers, dip it in water, and watch one color split into a rainbow! Brought to you by the MHS STEM Girls. For more information on these programs, please check the website frequently for updates or call us at 408-808-3052. Recommended for ages 5-12+ and Up Free. In-Person Registration Required. Participants can register for the program 30 minutes prior to start of program at information desk.

cases.refreshed: Technology moves very fast and sometimes it can feel overwhelming! Don't worry - San Jose Public Library is here to help! Seniors who have Apple or Android cellphones are welcome to come to our free presentation that will teach you the basics of how to use your device: how to install apps, how to take photos, how to message friends and family, and how to be safe while using your phone! Users of all skill-levels welcome!
